title: Diana Pasulka calls Chris Bledsoe a modern Paul Bennewitz

tellings.quote: So uh but Dian Pasoka came out and she said I think Chris Bledsoe is a modern Paul Benowitz.

plain: A researcher named Diana Pasulka has said publicly that Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man known for his own encounter claims, is "a modern Paul Bennewitz." Bennewitz was an Albuquerque man who in the early 1980s came to believe he was decoding alien messages, an episode that is said to have driven him to breakdown. Michels repeats Pasulka's remark himself, and the comparison would suggest Bledsoe is being fed a story the way Bennewitz was.
